key_catalyst: US launches fresh strikes on Iran and restores Strait of Hormuz blockade, pushing oil prices higher
reasoning: The restoration of the Strait of Hormuz blockade and a fourth consecutive night of US strikes on Iran mark a severe escalation of the geopolitical conflict that triggered a sharp risk-off selloff on July 13. Although pre-market gains show the market is currently shrugging off this threat in favor of ASML's strong earnings and lingering CPI relief, the active military escalation and hawkish pushback from Fed Chair Warsh present a high-severity catalyst that is likely to catch up with equities during the session.
